interpretations: Time in force, count of distinct matched orders (by `orders.recordvault`), share as a fraction of the total (0–1), and signed difference between that share and the mean share across time-in-force values
Time in force, count of distinct matched orders, share as a percentage of the total (0–100), and signed difference in percentage points between that share and the mean share
Time in force, count of distinct matched orders, share of the total, and absolute difference (unsigned) between that share and the mean share
Time in force, count of distinct matched orders, share of the total, and the share's difference from the mean share expressed relative to the mean (ratio or percent deviation)
Same as above, but the mean share is the simple average of the per-group shares, which equals 1 divided by the number of time-in-force values
Same as above, but the mean share is computed only over time-in-force values that have at least one matched risk/margin record
Same as above, but the mean share is computed over all possible time-in-force values (IOC, GTC, GTD, FOK), counting a group with no matches as share
Orders with a NULL `timespan` are included as their own group, so the total and mean share include that group
Orders with a NULL `timespan` are excluded, so the total and mean share cover only non-null time-in-force values
The total is the sum of per-group distinct matched order counts, which could double count an order if its `recordvault` appeared in multiple `orders` rows with different `timespan` values
The total is the number of distinct matched orders overall, regardless of time-in-force grouping
The total is the number of all orders, including those without risk/margin records, so the shares do not sum to

queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS time_in_force, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN orderexecutions e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
), s AS (
  SELECT time_in_force, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM c
)
SELECT time_in_force, order_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_diff_from_mean
FROM s;
WITH c AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt
  FROM orders o
  JOIN orderexecutions e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
s AS (
  SELECT timespan, cnt, cnt * 100.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share
  FROM c
)
SELECT timespan, cnt AS distinct_matched_orders, share AS share_pct,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_mean_pct_points
FROM s
WITH c AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt
  FROM orders o
  JOIN orderexecutions e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
s AS (
  SELECT timespan, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share
  FROM c
)
SELECT timespan, cnt AS distinct_matched_orders, share,
       ABS(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s)) AS abs_diff_from_mean_share
FROM s;
WITH c AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS matched_orders
  FROM orders o
  JOIN orderexecutions e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
), s AS (
  SELECT timespan, matched_orders, matched_orders * 1.0 / SUM(matched_orders) OVER () AS share_of_total
  FROM c
)
SELECT
  timespan,
  matched_orders,
  share_of_total,
  (share_of_total - AVG(share_of_total) OVER ()) / AVG(share_of_total) OVER () AS deviation_from_mean_share
FROM s;
SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders) AS share
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY timespan
);
SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share
FROM (
  SELECT o.timespan,
         COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders) AS share
  FROM orders o
  GROUP BY o.timespan
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM riskandmargin r WHERE r.ordervault = o.recordvault) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
) t;
